name: MRPEAT
description: A benchmark dataset for segmentation of pericardial adipose tissue in cardiac MR (CMR) images, presented alongside a triple-stage 3SUnet segmentation network.
reputation: Specialized medical imaging benchmark for pericardial adipose tissue segmentation; useful to researchers in cardiac imaging but not yet broadly adopted clinically.
notes: Relatively specialized and potentially small dataset; segmentation labels may have annotator variability. Non-LLM benchmark focused on medical imaging; clinical generalization should be validated.
